description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:123 and pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:72 - de_static_str leaks a heap allocation on every deserialization call. This is intentional but the memory growth is unbounded: deserializing N distinct strings leaks N allocations forever. The lib.rs comment says 'small allocation + leak' which is correct per-call but misleading about aggregate behavior. This is a documented design choice that is acceptable for the stated use-case (loading saved reports), but: (1) there is no warning about the memory growth in the doc comments, and (2) the pattern creates a trivial memory exhaustion vector if an adversary can cause repeated deserialization of distinct strings (e.g., from untrusted JSON). This is a P3/documentation gap with a security dimension.
title: Box::leak in de_static_str is undocumented memory leak
